items.title: Alibaba launches Wan3.0 video model with 30-second generation and document input
items.title_zh: Alibaba 发布 Wan3.0 视频模型，支持 30 秒生成与文档输入
items.summary: Alibaba Cloud has officially launched Wan3.0, a video-generation model that can create clips of up to 30 seconds and accept files including DOC, XLS and PPT.

items.title: Alibaba raises HK$80 billion through a share placement to fund AI infrastructure
items.title_zh: Alibaba 通过配股募资 800 亿港元，投入 AI 基础设施
items.summary: Alibaba priced a placement of 710 million new Hong Kong-listed shares at HK$112.70 each, raising HK$80 billion (US$10.21 billion) to fund AI infrastructure.

items.title: SHEIN launches Hong Kong IPO at a valuation of up to US$27 billion
items.title_zh: SHEIN 启动香港 IPO，估值最高达 270 亿美元
items.summary: SHEIN has started bookbuilding for its Hong Kong IPO, offering about 280 million Class B shares at HK$47.60 to HK$49.50 each in a listing that values the company at up to US$27 billion.

items.title: OpenAI: GPT 5.6 Sol price reduction (until at least Nov 21)
items.title_zh: OpenAI：GPT-5.6 Sol 降价（至少持续至 11 月 21 日）
items.summary: OpenAI's API pricing page lists promotional pricing for GPT-5.6 Sol that is available at least through November 21, 2026. The page also notes a 10% uplift on regional processing and FedRAMP endpoints, that priority processing was renamed Fast mode on July 30, 2026, and that GPT-Live 1 voice sessions are billed per second.

items.title: Executable Is a SQLite Database
items.title_zh: 你的可执行文件就是一个 SQLite 数据库
items.summary: The author describes a long-running interest in Nix and in replacing ELF with SQLite as an executable format, and argues that the two ideas fit together well.

items.title: Tether: iMessage, SMS, etc. on Linux
items.title_zh: Tether：在 Linux 上使用 iMessage、SMS 等服务
items.summary: After moving to Linux full time, the author missed Apple's Continuity features — sending and receiving iMessages and SMS, sharing files, syncing the clipboard and seeing iPhone notifications on the desktop — and presents Tether as a way to get them.

items.title: New EU-wide product repair rules come into force
items.title_zh: 欧盟全境产品维修新规生效
items.summary: EU-wide rules on repairing consumer goods have taken effect, with the stated goal of curbing the 35 million tonnes of waste that premature disposal produces across the bloc.

items.title: Andreessen Horowitz is investing billions into a bleak future
items.title_zh: Andreessen Horowitz 正把数十亿美元投向一个黯淡的未来
items.summary: A Model Republic article argues that the firm's investment portfolio is full of companies that have exploited legal loopholes, created disturbing products and broken the law.

items.title: SeL4 security proofs now complete on AArch64
items.title_zh: seL4 安全证明在 AArch64 上完成
items.summary: Proofcraft chief engineer Rafal Kolanski completed an "architecture split" overhaul of the seL4 proofs that removed 250,000 lines of proof and strengthened the link between proofs on different architectures. The changes are expected to significantly reduce future effort to maintain and extend the kernel's formal verification.

items.title: How Europe is killing makers and micro-entrepreneurs
items.title_zh: 欧洲如何扼杀创客与微型创业者
items.summary: A Lectronz article argues that the European Union's new packaging rules threaten makers and micro-entrepreneurs, putting jobs, livelihoods and an ecosystem of innovation at risk.

items.title: What's new in Emacs 31.1
items.title_zh: Emacs 31.1 有哪些新变化
items.summary: Emacs 31.1 adds a slew of quality-of-life features, retires its unexec dumper and brings general tree-sitter improvements, including a much-requested auto-installer for grammars.

items.title: Show HN: A techno machine in one HTML file, with verifiable renders
items.title_zh: Show HN：一个 HTML 文件里的 techno 音乐机器，渲染结果可验证
items.summary: A Show HN project presents a techno music machine contained in a single HTML file, with renders described as verifiable.

items.title: Peppermint oil reduces blood pressure by 8.48 mmHg in small study
items.title_zh: 薄荷油在小型研究中使血压降低 8.48 mmHg
items.summary: A 20-day randomized, placebo-controlled trial gave 40 people with pre- and stage 1 hypertension either 100 μL per day of peppermint oil or a peppermint-flavoured placebo, with the between-group difference in systolic blood pressure as the primary outcome. The report describes an 8.48 mmHg reduction in this small study.

items.title: Xiaomi: New CPU matches Apple cores single threaded, much faster multithreaded
items.title_zh: Xiaomi：新 CPU 单线程性能比肩 Apple 核心，多线程大幅领先
items.summary: A social media post claims that a new Xiaomi CPU matches Apple cores in single-threaded performance and is much faster in multithreaded workloads.

items.title: Anna's Archive Owes $340 Million, Lost Several Domains, but It's Still Online
items.title_zh: Anna's Archive 欠款 3.4 亿美元、失去多个域名，但仍在运营
items.summary: According to TorrentFreak, Anna's Archive owes $340 million and has lost several domains but remains online. When the site suffered widespread downtime this month, users feared another legal enforcement action.

items.title: MS Paint and Photos inivisibly watermark even locally generated output with GUID
items.title_zh: MS Paint 和 Photos 会为本地生成的图片嵌入不可见 GUID 水印
items.summary: A reverse-engineering write-up describes how Microsoft Paint and Photos embed a server-issued GUID into the pixels of AI images generated locally.

items.title: IPFS Maintainers Winding Down
items.title_zh: IPFS 维护团队即将停止运作
items.summary: The team at Shipyard says its IPFS funding was cancelled, news it shared with the IPFS and wider peer-to-peer community.

items.title: Jabber/XMPP: 25 Years of Digital Independence
items.title_zh: Jabber/XMPP：25 年的数字独立
items.summary: An essay marking 25 years of Jabber/XMPP reflects on who "we" refers to when people say infrastructure should be owned, ranging from highways and water supply to housing.

items.title: Coding expertise is going to collapse from AI reliance
items.title_zh: 对 AI 的依赖将导致编程专业能力崩塌
items.summary: An opinion essay argues that long-term skill formation requires ongoing friction, and that reliance on AI coding tools will erode coding expertise.

items.title: The entire city of San Francisco as a video game
items.title_zh: 整个旧金山城被做成电子游戏
items.summary: A project presents the entire city of San Francisco as a video game.

items.title: ENGINEAI says general-purpose humanoid robot costs have fallen below RMB100,000
items.title_zh: ENGINEAI 称通用人形机器人成本已降至 10 万元人民币以下
items.summary: ENGINEAI, the Shenzhen-based humanoid robot maker, says the cost of a general-purpose humanoid robot capable of performing practical tasks has fallen below RMB100,000.

items.title: NAND maker YMTC’s RMB33 billion Shanghai IPO application accepted
items.title_zh: NAND 厂商 YMTC 330 亿元人民币上海 IPO 申请获受理
items.summary: Yangtze Memory Technologies Holdings, China's NAND flash memory maker, has had its application for a RMB33 billion listing on Shanghai's STAR Market accepted.

items.title_zh: Alibaba 发布 Wan3.0 视频模型，支持 30 秒生成与文档输入
items.summary: Alibaba Cloud has officially launched Wan3.0, a video-generation model that can create clips of up to 30 seconds and accept files including DOC, XLS and PPT.

items.title: Fuyao lists a solar sunroof capable of producing 150 watts per square meter
items.title_zh: Fuyao 上架可每平方米发电 150 瓦的太阳能天窗
items.summary: Fuyao Group has added a solar sunroof to its automotive glass product lineup, saying the integrated solar-cell system can produce up to 150 watts per square meter.

items.title: Alibaba raises HK$80 billion through a share placement to fund AI infrastructure
items.title_zh: Alibaba 通过配股募资 800 亿港元，投入 AI 基础设施
items.summary: Alibaba priced a placement of 710 million new Hong Kong-listed shares at HK$112.70 each, raising HK$80 billion (US$10.21 billion) to fund AI infrastructure.

items.title_zh: SHEIN 启动香港 IPO，估值最高达 270 亿美元
items.summary: SHEIN has started bookbuilding for its Hong Kong IPO, offering about 280 million Class B shares at HK$47.60 to HK$49.50 each in a listing that values the company at up to US$27 billion.

items.title: amosblomqvist/learn
items.title_zh: amosblomqvist/learn：个人 AI 学习系统
items.summary: A TypeScript repository that its author describes as a personal AI learning system.

items.title: typesafe-ai/skills
items.title_zh: typesafe-ai/skills：基于 TypeSafe System One API 的 Agent 技能集
items.summary: This repository collects agent skills aimed at developers building on TypeSafe's System One API.

items.title: software-mansion-labs/goldie
items.title_zh: software-mansion-labs/goldie：Agent 应用商店预览与截图工具
items.summary: A TypeScript project offering previews and screenshots for agentic apps.

items.title: bryllim/workout-guide
items.title_zh: bryllim/workout-guide：302 张开放健身动作插图与 npm 包
items.summary: An Astro project from Bryl Lim that bundles 302 open exercise illustrations with a framework-neutral npm package.

items.title: yejy53/Editable-Design
items.title_zh: yejy53/Editable-Design：Agent 驱动的可编辑视觉设计生成
items.summary: A Python project for agent-driven creation of editable, tastefully crafted visual artifacts.

items.title: yding-git/personal-edge-proxy
items.title_zh: yding-git/personal-edge-proxy：多入口多出口个人代理方案
items.summary: A personal proxy setup combining multiple inbound and outbound options with Xray, Hysteria2, REALITY Vision and WARP, plus optional static SOCKS5 routing.

items.title: danielravina/stemkit
items.title_zh: danielravina/stemkit：把任意 YouTube 歌曲拆分为音轨
items.summary: A TypeScript tool for splitting any YouTube song into separate stems.

items.title: Quantifying System-Level Harms from AI Adoption in Complex Sociotechnical Systems
items.title_zh: 量化复杂社会技术系统中 AI 应用带来的系统级危害
items.summary: Proposes a framework that links structured hazard analysis, component-level testing, and probabilistic system modelling to trace model behaviour to system-level outcomes. Applied to the UK's Real Time Gross Settlement system, adversarial manipulation of LLM-based trading measurably shifted recommendations and, in a financial contagion model, increased bank failures and lowered the shock threshold for cascading disruption, particularly under widespread or monopolistic AI adoption.

items.title: Names Can Hurt: Spotting Slopsquatting Risks Caused by Package Name Hallucinations in Local Coding LLMs
items.title_zh: 名称亦能伤人：识别本地代码大模型包名幻觉引发的恶意抢注风险
items.summary: Proposes a two-layer detector that combines a deterministic PyPI existence check with a Random Forest classifier over ten name- and metadata-derived features, embedded in a LangGraph pipeline that retries at escalating temperatures and falls back to a stronger model. Across 300 curated prompts the pipeline produced hallucination-free code on 76% of runs, and the authors report hallucination rates rising from 0–10% on routine coding prompts to 40–73% on slopsquat baits.

items.title: BenchBench-Protocol: Evaluating Real-World Wet-Lab Protocol Reasoning and Modification
items.title_zh: BenchBench-Protocol：评估真实湿实验室实验方案推理与修改能力
items.summary: Introduces a benchmark of 149 protocol-modification tasks reconstructed from the changes scientists made to published wet-lab protocols, drawn from 96 source protocols across nine domains of wet-lab biology. Across nine closed and open models, Claude Opus 5 scores highest at 59.2% normalized rubric score while the others fall between 34.1% and 47.1%, and the benchmark remains unsaturated when taking the best of ten attempts.

items.title: Continual Visual Learning under Evolving Semantic Concept Shift
items.title_zh: 语义概念演化漂移下的持续视觉学习
items.summary: Formalizes evolving semantic concept shift, in which taxonomies and concept definitions change so that the same visual evidence requires a different interpretation, and proposes SemReWrite, which localizes affected regions and applies input-dependent low-rank rewriting with structured semantic memory and obsolete-decision suppression. It also introduces the EvoShift-Bench suite and new metrics for selective revision, on which SemReWrite is reported to balance learning revised semantics against preserving unaffected knowledge better than prompt replacement, fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, and continual-learning baselines.

items.title: Retrieval-augmented generation vs. deterministic tax computation in multi-agent financial advisory: A 2x2 factorial experiment
items.title_zh: 检索增强生成与确定性税务计算在多智能体财务顾问中的对比：一项 2x2 析因实验
items.summary: Builds a capital-gains calculation engine and a RAG vector store of market advisory reports as context providers for a multi-agent trade recommendation system, then tests their effects in a 2x2 repeated-measures experiment. Enabling the tax engine significantly reduced tax savings by roughly 55 percentage points relative to no-engine conditions, while the RAG main effect and the interaction were not significant and the RAG-only condition had the highest descriptive mean savings at 47.7%.

items.title: The Loss Floor of Denoising Score Matching: Fisher Geometry from Schrödinger Bridges
items.title_zh: 去噪分数匹配的损失下限：来自薛定谔桥的 Fisher 几何
items.summary: Shows that the irreducible excess in the denoising score matching loss, which arises because the conditional score stays random at a fixed noisy state, equals the trace of the Fisher–Rao metric of the conditional endpoint family integrated along the diffusion trajectory. Derived from a Schrödinger bridge variational principle, the result yields a closed form for Gaussian corruption and shows that raw losses under different noise ranges or weightings need not rank models consistently because they contain different additive floors.
